title: Complexes of an abelian category form an abelian category; short exactness is degreewise; the second map of a short exact sequence is a cokernel of the first
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)$ be the category of cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ indexed by $\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then: (1) $\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)$ is an abelian category; (2) a sequence $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ of morphisms of complexes with $g\circ f=0$ is short exact in $\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)$ ($f$ a monomorphism, $g$ an epimorphism, exact at $B$) if and only if for every $r\in\mathbf Z$ the sequence $0\to A^r\xrightarrow{f^r}B^r\xrightarrow{g^r}C^r\to0$ is short exact in $\mathcal A$; (3) in a short exact sequence $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ of an abelian category (in particular of $\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)$), $g$ is an epimorphism and a cokernel of $f$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0114 (label lemma-cat-cochain-abelian, line 3113): the category of cochain complexes is abelian, injectivity, surjectivity and exactness are degreewise; clause (3): Tag 0109 (definition-abelian-category, line 608), an epimorphism of an abelian category is the cokernel of its kernel

mathlib_searches.query: category of homological complexes in an abelian category is abelian; short exact iff degreewise short exact
a short complex of homological complexes in an abelian category is short exact iff it is short exact in each degree
